source.description: Mapping derived from main.py, solver/*.py, datasets/*.py, and experiments/{cmnist,waterbirds}/*.py at base commit 66c282b.

notes: Both classes are exported by datasets/__init__.py.
The checked-in experiments/cmnist scripts use LISAColoredMNIST, while experiments/coloredmnist_ecmp.py uses ColoredMNIST.
These constructions have different splits and must be reported separately rather than silently aliased.
The class selected by main.py is CounterfactualWaterbirdsDataset or CounterfactualWaterbirdsClipDataset.
Its internal CLIP dataset name is waterbirds-cf-clip and its split list includes counterfactual.
Plain Waterbirds is not assumed equivalent; candidates using it are flagged and not accepted by the strict filter.

probing.meaning: Frozen precomputed CLIP features and a linear classifier.

cnn.meaning: MNIST_CNN path in ERM._initialize_model; normally used without CLIP preprocessing.

finetune.meaning: No explicit CLIP-finetune flag exists in base main.py. Nonlinear non-CNN runs are surfaced as candidates but must be verified manually.

notes: ECMP is the codebase name for the paper's closed-form GRIT method.
ECMP.cal_project computes a rank-param1 low-rank SVD basis and applies I - U U^T before ERM.
conditional randomly matches same-label examples from different domains.
nearest chooses cross-domain nearest neighbours within label.
oracle loads the precomputed dataset.diff tensor.

param2.ECMP: present in some sweep configs as a pair-count setting, but pair subsampling is commented out at base commit 66c282b
param2.MatchDG: present in some sweep configs but unused by the checked-in MatchDG implementation

hyperparameters.param3: Parsed globally but not used by the Table 1 solvers in the checked-in base code.

optimizer.selection: ERM selects dataset.default_optimizer; optimizer is not exposed by base main.py.
optimizer.warning: The paper says Adam for both datasets, but the checked-in defaults disagree for ColoredMNIST and CounterfactualWaterbirds. W&B config alone cannot prove the optimizer for those names; code snapshots or logs are needed.

colored_mnist.notes: ERM.report names selection on the in_test split as in-domain validation and stores the paired OOD test result in scalar summary fields.

waterbirds_cf.notes: The base Waterbirds dataset has val and test but no in_test split. Base ERM.report does not save the val-selected paired test dictionary, so matching may have to rely on the latest nested test summary or run history.

waterbirds_construction.verification: Prefer a W&B dataset artifact digest/version. If no dataset artifact was logged, the run config only provides root_dir and cannot confirm the exact metadata.csv contents.
